name: NGC 1275 (3C 84)
notes: Real ALMA HCN 3-2 cube (project 2018.1.01178.S, member uid://A001/X133d/X422c, spw25, 260.35-262.18 GHz, 126 channels of ~17 km/s, primary-beam corrected, 2646x2646 spaxels, 3.4 GB). The cube itself is not committed (multi-GB); fetch it from the ALMA archive with astroquery.alma get_data_info(uid) and the product name NGC1275_sci.spw25.cube.I.pbcor.fits. The committed spectrum is a 41x41-pixel box extraction (pipeline/extract_cube_spectrum.py --box 41) with peak S/N ~3.8.
